title: NASA-UAP-D019, Gemini 5 Technical Debriefing, Part I, 1965
doc_notes: This document is a preliminary transcript of the Gemini 5 flight crew technical debriefing conducted by NASA in 1965. / This document is a preliminary transcript of the Gemini 5 flight crew technical debriefing conducted by NASA in 1965; it contains detailed accounts of mission events, sensor operations, and observations.

incidents.summary: Gemini 5 crew reported window fogging and frozen condensation between the outer panes of glass during countdown.
incidents.quote: Each window was filthy. Just fogged completely over, and it was on the inside of the outer pane of glass.

incidents.summary: Crew observed small debris, including a bee, a fly, and flecks of material, trapped between the outer sealed panes of the spacecraft window.
incidents.quote: I had a small bee, and I had a fly, and I had several flecks of things

incidents.summary: Crew observed debris and gray spots on the windshield immediately following fairing jettison.
incidents.quote: I noted about 5 or 6, I saw them hit , 5 or 6 gray splots, just small ones

incidents.summary: Crew reported hearing two distinct 'ding' sounds on the hatch, similar to a pellet or BB impact, while in orbit.
incidents.quote: right over my head something dinged the hatch. Just bigger than heck - dinged.

incidents.summary: Gemini 5 crew observed a cyclone off Japan.
incidents.quote: cyclone off Japan which has been added into there

incidents.summary: Gemini 5 crew observed a recovery ship (Lake Champlain) visually.
incidents.quote: We saw him visually - found him visually

incidents.summary: Gemini 5 crew observed unidentified radar signals while over China/Tibet.
incidents.quote: I know darn well it must have been--Russian radar
